warmup: One immediate complete assertion after navigation; each scenario uses a fresh browser, context and document.

acceptance.rationale: Engineering resource gate declared before the matrix: flag over 10% CPU time or peak-memory growth and over 5% complete-time growth using the median paired reference/candidate ratio. Six groups cover all six orders of three engines. These six independent observations per scenario support bootstrap intervals and observed maxima, not percentile-tail or release claims.

exclusionPolicy: Retain every attempted scenario and launch. Any unexpected outcome invalidates the whole comparison; never discard slow samples or rerun selectively.
scope: Single worker with matched concurrent pending assertions. Complete process-tree CPU and memory include preparation, the fixed application work, backend waiting, assertions and cleanup. This is not a worker-contention or native Linux release gate.
